title: Glasshouse and Postcards
author: Silas Ishikawa
blurb: Theo Okafor, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the demolition date arrives.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
